LESSON: THREE- DIMENSION OBJECTS

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Geometry

• Today’s class: Three- Dimension Objects

Try this

• Solve all three and show working.

• Show working for one Three- Dimension Objects question.
